messages.author: 67dd8164f9bfa181
messages.subject: ChromosomeExplorer options
parts:
Dear Hendrik et al.,

I have written my own web interface for search & display of aberrant
regions, which relies on the regions.xls and PNG files generated by
ChromosomeExplorer. Are there any parameters (besides chromosome
selection) which can be passed to modify the processing? At least, I
would love to be able to limit PNG generation to one or two zoom
levels.

Thanks for comments,

Michael.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] ChromosomeExplorer options
parts:
Hi,

you can pass argument 'zooms', e.g. process(ce, zooms=...). The
default is zooms=2^(0:7).

/Henrik
